question: Who has been appointed as the Executive Director of the Reserve Bank of India in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohit Jain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Rohit Jain

 
 
• **Rohit Jain **has been **appointed **as **Executive Director **of **RBI **with effect from **December 11, 2020**.
 
• **Prior **to **being promoted to ED**, he was serving as **Chief General Manager-in-Charge**, of the **Department of Supervision**.
